arguments.name: project_context

arguments.name: detail_level

prompts.description: Generate risk monitoring report tracking risk status and response effectiveness

prompts.description: Track and manage project issues that have materialized from risks or emerged unexpectedly

prompts.description: Identify and analyze positive risks (opportunities) and exploitation strategies
